lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Seriously, again?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Y-yeah...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-it was a yogurt commercial this time...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: They, um... suddenly decided to go with Yoyo instead...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What is that, the fifth time now?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-if we count the soda ad too, that makes four...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... This is seriously pissing me off.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: ... I'm sure of it now. This goes beyond a personal grudge.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Yeah, Tetra's got it out for us.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: If they're pushing Yoyo this hard, we're definitely on their radar.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Do you have any idea why?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: ... Beats me. Should we just ask Boss directly?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: We're done for today, right?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Ah, yeah. We did have one more, but it got canceled because the place caught fire.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... Everyone made it out okay?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: N-no one's hurt. It seems the ceiling's only slightly burnt, so I don't think the damage is too bad...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: ... Wh-where are you going?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm gonna see Yoyo.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: She's not someone you can just go see whenever you want. You know that, right?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I don't care. I'll stake it out if I have to.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I need to see what's really going on.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm heading out. Make sure Boss knows where I'll be.
Anis heads for the door.
She swings it wide open, and Yoyo is standing there, right in front of her.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What are you doing here...?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'd like a word.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Great, I've got something to say too.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'll keep this short. I didn't have anything to do with your ads being taken.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: That was the company's decision, not mine.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And what the heck am I supposed to do with that?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Don't get the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I know you hate me, but I still consider us colleagues chasing the same dream.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I would never stoop to something so beneath me.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Drop the act. It's pathetic.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You really think we'd lose it and start exposing you over a couple of ads?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I already told you I'm not doing that.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You're almost out of time. So brace yourself. I'm about to crush you with actual skill, got it?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Don't make assumptions.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I came here to clear up a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: You expect us to believe that?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: So you're the new manager for T.T. STAR. I'm Yoyo. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: You don't remember me?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'm sorry, should I know you...?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Guys! Look at this!
Mint's urgent shout cuts through the space, and all eyes snap to the TV.
A news segment on the entertainment industry is airing on the Central Government channel.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: If I understand what you're saying, Yoyo is number one on the major record charts,

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: and T.T. STAR is... where again on the indie charts?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: 19th.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Right. So you're saying Yoyo's been targeting T.T. STAR, currently 19th on the indie charts?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: That's right, she's been snatching every ad that they land,

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: though calling them ads might be a stretch.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wait, why would she? It's not like she needs to.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Let's take a look at this.
A photo of a desk covered in scribbles fills the screen.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: What are we looking at?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: This is Anis's school desk from back when she was still human.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Whoa... that's pretty serious. Isn't that flower what you usually see at funerals?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: This just looks like full-on group bullying...

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wait, don't tell me. The one who started this is...?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: You guessed it: Yoyo, the chart-topping pop star.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So let me get this straight. Yoyo bullied Anis back in school,

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: and that's still going on now that they're Nikkes?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: That's the most reasonable way to read it, yes.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: And this is from a reliable source?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Of course, we've got verified statements from most of her former classmates.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: See the QR code below? You can check out the interviews and related materials there.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wow, that's pretty brutal... As if bullying her back in school wasn't enough, she still kept at it even after Anis became a Nikke.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: I mean... with money and fame, messing up someone's life isn't exactly hard, right?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: But seriously, what would Yoyo even get out of all that?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Who knows?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: People don't always need a reason to be malicious.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Haha, yeah, fair enough. So what's Tetra Line's take on this?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Of course, they're denying it. But here's where things get interesting: we've come across some very telling evidence.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: We've confirmed that large sums were deposited into the accounts of the top executives behind the ads Yoyo took from T.T. STAR.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wait, don't tell me Tetra Line pulled some strings?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Seems that way.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So Tetra knew what Yoyo was up to and even helped her out?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: And you've got credible evidence for that?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: The data comes from Elysion and Missilis's finance teams.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wait, why would they provide that?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Well, it's a competitive industry, after all.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wow, guess nothing stays a secret these days, huh?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Folks, better behave yourselves. You never know what might come back to bite you.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Anyway, moving on.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Elysion's AZX has been delayed by 30 minutes. The cause is... Wow, looks like Nikkephobia's still a thing.
The TV chatters on in the background, but Anis doesn't hear any of it.
She turns to Yoyo, who's already staring right at her.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: You...!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wait, no...
Yoyo takes a step back.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I already told you... it was a misunderstanding!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I apologized!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: What more do you want from me?!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: No, seriously, hear me out. We have no idea what's going on...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Whatever happened to crushing me with your skills alone?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Is this what you call skill?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Hey,

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: stop playing the victim.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I really don't get why you think you can look at us like that and say those things.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: None of what they said was wrong. You bullied Anis. You stole our ads.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Did you seriously think one apology would make it all better? You must live a pretty cushy life if so.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... Hah.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Fine, have it your way.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I had fun watching you writhe, so I played with you a little.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I even showed mercy and let you live your little dream, but you got cocky.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: All right. I'll deal with you the way I used to. Looks like that's what you wanted, anyway.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... Heh, some things never change, huh?
*Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz, bzzz*
Yoyo picks up her phone.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: mustang_past_op_l
lines.text: Where the hell are you?! Get your ass here, right now!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Why are you yelling?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I saw it too, but we can sort th—

lines.speaker: mustang_past_op_l
lines.text: Get over here...! Before I go and end you myself!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Understood.
Yoyo breaks into a run,
then glances back once and Anis meets her eyes.
It's the same mocking stare
Anis always sees in her dreams.
After she's gone, the office is left with nothing but the sound of the TV.
*Craaash!*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You useless piece of junk!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You said it was fine! You told me not to worry!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Wh-why are you making such a fuss?! If we just release the audio, it'll all be fine...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: We submitted it, and they flagged it as tampered immediately!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You know why?! Because Elysion and Missilis had their top experts verify every second!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Elysion... and Missilis? Why would they...?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: How would I know?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You absolute moron! Why would you go out of your way to expose yourself like that?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: If you were gonna do something that stupid, you might as well have gone on air and said it outright!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: "Oh, that new pop star? Yeah, she's just some poor girl I used to bully back in school, so be nice to her, everyone!"

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: A weakness is something you bury, not something you dig up yourself! What the hell is wrong with your head, huh?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You were ugly as hell, chasing after some stupid fantasy, then you get turned into a heap of scrap, and they redid your entire face!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You got handed a clean slate on a silver platter! You could've started over! Instead, you go and show everyone the skeletons in your closet like a damn lunatic!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: B-but... you told me to go over there and start something with them...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: When did I ever do that?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Go on, say it.
Mustang taps Yoyo on the forehead with his finger. Her head lolls, completely limp.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: When did I say something like that, huh?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'm... sorry.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Argh! Damn it! Damn it!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Is there... no other way?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Enough, cut it out.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I said stop. I don't know how, but now Elysion and Missilis are involved.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: If this were just rumors, I could've buried it. But it's not, is it?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You did bully her. You did steal those ads.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So drop it, I'm not letting Tetra get dragged down with you.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: But we were... in this together, weren't we...?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: What are you even talking about?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Tetra Line, the top of the industry, getting involved in some star's petty grudge?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Did you really think that was gonna happen?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: No... of course not.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Exactly. It's all on you, so you're the one taking the fall.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: P-please... just give me one more chance...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Get out!
*Craaash!*
Yoyo staggers away, dazed.
The door clicks shut behind her, and Mustang slams his fist on the desk.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Damn it!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That rust bucket doesn't matter. I can cut her loose anytime.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The real problem is Elysion and Missilis.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Damn vultures, they actually brought in their finance team for something this trivial?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: What are they after? Why come after me out of nowhere?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Why get involved in something this insignificant?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: There's no reason for them to target me in the first place...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Unless...
Hanson watches the news story playing on a massive TV.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: We've taken a keen interest in why Tetra Line hasn't collapsed.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: Mustang is... something of an anomaly.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: Go on, say it. He's a total screw-up. No need to sugarcoat it.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: Well, yes, there's no better way to put it.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: He may be the CEO of one of the Big Three, with strong ties to the Central Government and V.T.C...

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: But I've always wondered how Tetra hasn't collapsed, considering he behaves like a rabid dog.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: And he's got a pretty good public image, too.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: So it was you behind all of this.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: I assumed you were just there to fill a chair, but you've been quite skilled at working things from the shadows.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: It's no exaggeration to say Tetra has you to thank for surviving this long.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You flatter me.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: I don't make a habit of saying this, but I've always been curious about you.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: So when you requested a secure line, we came...

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: And all you have is this? A complete waste of our time.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: That's cute, you actually thought we'd stick our noses into that pop star nonsense?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I know you both dislike Mustang.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, we're not exactly fans.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: He got lucky discovering a single pop star, Tetra's stock shot up, and now he's insufferably smug.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: But that's a separate issue. Why should Missilis or Elysion bother digging up Tetra's dirty laundry?

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: No need to make a corporate drama out of this.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: Besides, the data is insignificant. Any private investigator could have gotten it in a day.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: So there's absolutely no reason for us to waste our time on it.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: It'd carry much more weight coming from you than from some no-name detective agency.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Besides,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: it could give the impression that you're targeting Tetra Line.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: So why exactly are we going after Tetra?

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: Do you really think two companies of our scale would act on your personal feelings? You're still a child.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: See if you can bribe Mustang's personal physician.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: ... His personal physician?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: After that, you may each decide whether to assist me.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'm confident you'll find it worthwhile.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Honestly, it's not exactly profitable for me, but think of it as an investment in what comes next.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: ... I've got a rough idea of what you're getting at.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: Fine. If your information proves worthwhile, we'll assist.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: After all, good intel comes at a price.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: All right, we'll review it, then decide.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Understood, I'd appreciate your help.
Hanson pulls out his phone and logs into an online forum.
Title: I knew Yoyo would pull something like this
Title: Yoyo is seriously vicious
Title: You really can't judge people by their appearances
Title: Anis must be having a rough time
Title: She's still gets bullied even after dying, WTF
Title: How did they even endure all that?
Then he checks the indie charts.
13th place.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Fine, I hate to admit it, but you were right.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I suppose there's a part of me that enjoys watching others suffer.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Heh... haha.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So it was you, Hanson.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: No idea how you got those idiots wrapped around your finger, but this just got interesting.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Heh.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's my boy.
